title: Threat & Endpoint Protection: Intelligent Defense Architecture| Quadra
description: Quadra, a global award-winning partner, architects the Intelligent Enterprise for the world's leading businesses. We transform complex Cloud & AI innovation into a competitive advantage, built on 25 years of deep, vendor-agnostic architectural expertise.

blocks.text: Endpoints are the new front line. How do you defend against sophisticated threats like ransomware and fileless malware when your workforce is distributed and your attack surface is constantly changing?

blocks.alt: 3 women sitting on chair in front of table with laptop computers

blocks.text: We architect an AI-powered defense fabric. Our blueprint leverages the industry-leading EDR and XDR platforms from CrowdStrike and Sophos. We move beyond simple antivirus to engineer a solution that provides deep visibility, behavioral threat detection, and rapid, orchestrated response across your entire digital estate.

We leverage industry-leading EDR and XDR platforms from CrowdStrike and Sophos to provide deep visibility, AI-powered threat detection, and rapid, orchestrated response across your entire digital estate.
Expert deployment of CrowdStrike Falcon and Sophos Intercept X for real-time, AI-driven protection.
